Read INMET observations lazily

Source: R/query.R
read_inmet.Rd

Downloads the selected yearly Parquet files to the cache once and returns a lazy table. Filter and summarise it with dplyr, then call dplyr::collect() to bring the result into R.

Usage

read_inmet(table = c("daily", "hourly"), years = NULL)

Arguments

table

Either "daily" or "hourly".

years

Years to download; NULL selects all available years.

Value

A lazy dbplyr table backed by DuckDB.

Details

Values are INMET's as published, except that -9999 and blanks become NA. The release applies no outlier filter or coverage threshold. Its last year is usually partial: the 2026-10-24 release ends on 28 February 2025.

Hourly table

One row per station and hour in INMET's files, including hours where every measurement is missing.

ColumnMeaning
code_stationINMET station code

date_local, month, day, hour_localLocal date and its parts, at the station's fixed standard UTC offset (no daylight saving)
yearUTC year; years selects on it
precip_mmPrecipitation in the hour, mm
pressure_station_hpaStation pressure, hPa
pressure_max_hpa, pressure_min_hpaPressure extremes in the previous hour, hPa
radiation_kj_m2Global radiation, kJ/m²
temp_dry_bulb_cDry-bulb air temperature, °C
temp_dew_point_cDew-point temperature, °C
temp_max_c, temp_min_cAir-temperature extremes in the previous hour, °C
temp_dew_point_max_c, temp_dew_point_min_cDew-point extremes in the previous hour, °C
rel_humidity_pctRelative humidity, %
rel_humidity_max_pct, rel_humidity_min_pctRelative-humidity extremes in the previous hour, %
wind_direction_degWind direction, degrees
wind_speed_msWind speed, m/s
wind_gust_msMaximum gust in the previous hour, m/s
code_muni, name_muni, abbrev_stateStation's IBGE municipality code, name, and state

Daily table

The pipeline aggregates hourly rows by station and date_local. Every available hour contributes, and an aggregate is NA only when all of its hourly inputs are missing, so a daily sum is never zero for lack of data.

ColumnMeaning
code_stationINMET station code
dateLocal date
year, month, dayParts of the local date; years selects on year
day_of_yearDay of the year, 1–366
week, weekdayISO week (1–53) and ISO weekday (Monday = 1)
n_hoursHours with at least one non-missing measurement, 0–24
n_hours_temp_meanHours contributing to the daily mean temperature, 0–24
n_hours_temp_min, n_hours_temp_maxHours contributing to the daily temperature extremes, including the dry-bulb fallback, 0–24
n_hours_temp_dew_point_meanHours contributing to the daily mean dew point, 0–24
n_hours_rel_humidity_meanHours contributing to the daily mean relative humidity, 0–24
n_hours_rel_humidity_min, n_hours_rel_humidity_maxHours contributing to the daily humidity extremes, including the hourly fallback, 0–24
n_hours_precip_totalHours contributing to the daily precipitation total, 0–24
n_hours_radiation_totalHours contributing to the daily radiation total, 0–24
n_hours_pressure_station_meanHours contributing to the daily mean station pressure, 0–24
n_hours_wind_speed_meanHours contributing to the daily mean wind speed, 0–24
n_hours_wind_gust_maxHours contributing to the daily maximum gust, 0–24
temp_mean_cMean dry-bulb temperature, °C
temp_min_c, temp_max_cLowest and highest hourly air-temperature extreme, °C; see below
temp_dew_point_mean_cMean dew-point temperature, °C
rel_humidity_mean_pctMean relative humidity, %
rel_humidity_min_pct, rel_humidity_max_pctLowest and highest hourly relative-humidity extreme, %; see below
precip_total_mmTotal precipitation, mm
radiation_total_kj_m2Total global radiation, kJ/m²
pressure_station_mean_hpaMean station pressure, hPa
wind_speed_mean_msMean wind speed, m/s
wind_gust_max_msHighest gust, m/s
code_muni, name_muni, abbrev_stateStation's IBGE municipality code, name, and state

Three features of the daily table need care.

  • Empty days. INMET's files list hours with no measurements, so the daily table has rows with n_hours == 0 and every measurement NA. Counting rows per station-year therefore counts calendar days, not days with data. Filter on n_hours first.

  • n_hours counts hours with any measurement. A day can have n_hours == 24 while one variable is missing all day. Each n_hours_* column counts the non-missing hourly inputs of its own aggregate, so use it to filter coverage for that variable. The counts include both the previous-hour extreme and its hourly fallback for temp_min_c, temp_max_c, rel_humidity_min_pct, and rel_humidity_max_pct. Schema 3 adds these columns; the pinned 2026-10-24 release predates them, and on that release the hourly table gives the same counts.

  • Extremes fall back to the hourly reading. For each hour, temp_max_c uses the hourly maximum when present and temp_dry_bulb_c otherwise. temp_min_c, rel_humidity_max_pct and rel_humidity_min_pct work the same way. When the extreme field is missing for long spells, the daily extremes come from the hourly reading alone.

Known data problems

The release keeps INMET's values, including some implausible temperatures that n_hours filters do not catch.

StationYearsProblem
A201 Belém/PA2005–2006The 99th percentile of hourly temp_max_c minus temp_dry_bulb_c is 5.8 °C, against 3.9 °C across all stations, and daily maxima reach 44–45 °C
A303 Maceió/AL2004–200560 and 92 days with temp_max_c of 35 °C or more, against at most 5 in any later year
A409 Aracaju/SE2021Hourly temp_max_c missing on 130 days; daily maxima reach 35 °C or more on 73 days, 70 of them from the dry-bulb fallback, against at most 3 in other years

No temperature in the release exceeds 45.0 °C, and values do not bunch at 45.0 °C. Treat readings near 45 °C with suspicion.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive()
daily <- read_inmet("daily", 2024)
dplyr::collect(dplyr::filter(daily, .data$code_muni == 3550308L))

# Hours per day with a measured temp_max_c, to drop days that rely on the
# dry-bulb fallback
read_inmet("hourly", 2021) |>
  dplyr::filter(.data$code_station == "A409") |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_hours_temp_max = sum(as.integer(!is.na(.data$temp_max_c)), na.rm = TRUE),
    .by = c("code_station", "date_local")
  ) |>
  dplyr::collect()

# Schema 3 counts include fallback readings for daily extremes.
if ("n_hours_temp_max" %in% colnames(daily)) {
  daily |>
    dplyr::filter(.data$n_hours_temp_max >= 18) |>
    dplyr::collect()
}
}
